name: Ryuugasaki Sasari
source: [url=https://vndb.org/c145820]Rindo[/url] during her lifetime. A former prostitute who married into the Ryuugasaki family. Having been forced into an unwanted marriage with the young lord of the Ryuugasaki family, she manages to stay strong by using her child as her reason for living.
